text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
K.S. Miracle is 1st!!
Another victory for K.S. Miracle!!

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
She displayed phenomenal speed once again today.
It's already been announced that her next race will be the Sprinters Stakes, but—

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
As K.S. Miracle is now,
she is truly worthy of being crowned
champion of the festival of speed.

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text: "We definitely have high hopes for a victory at the Sprinters Stakes!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOO!)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hah... *pant*... *cough*...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Running... worthy of being the fastest.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(...Actually, that felt good.
With this speed—!)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Haa, ngh... I will win.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm going to win.
In the Sprinters Stakes...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With feelings akin to praying and clinging to hope, I gaze down the underground tunnel.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That was all that could be done right now.
All one could do was pray that the ruin creeping closer and closer
would not arrive today—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...âAh.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer... san...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I dashed over to support her before I even had time to think.
...And then, the reality sank in.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... ahaha.
I'm sorry, Trainer.
I just tripped a little.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I'm drenched in sweat...
And besides, I must've been heavy, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Helping her up was remarkably easy.
Against the palm supporting her back,
I could feel the knobby bumps of her spine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through that touch, I understood once again.
This is what it means to run by giving your all,
this is what it means to run staking everything.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so. ...Even so.
She's running with full understanding of what it entails.
And I was the one who pushed her forward in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To her, running was the very meaning of life.
To give her irresponsible hope only to strip it away now would be far too cruel.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Knowing it all along, understanding every bit of it,
every single thing—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...My vision clears.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...?
Um... Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That was when, at long last,
I felt like I was truly looking at K.S.Miracle for the first time in a while.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
K.S. Miracle. The Umamusume I train.
Kind, hardworking, fragile,
and apparently quite stubborn—and yet—
choice_data_list: (She's the Uma Musume I swore I'd support.)
(She's the Umamusume I swore to support.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...U-Um.
For now... let's head to the waiting room."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: We also need to talk about what's next…… right?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Well then, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
For our next race... please make it the
Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sure this is against your wishes.
Even so, please."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: In return... I promise, I'll definitely win.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Confidence too. ...To be honest, I have plenty.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the miracle of everyone who helped me run this far.
Thanks to Trainer-san who raised me—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Right now.
'Now' is when I'm at my fastest."
choice_data_list: True... you've gotten faster, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yes... That is why it must be "now."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...... It has to be 『now』.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"K.S. Miracle murmurs low and heavy.
Bleeding through her voice is determination, resolve... and impatience."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By nature, the period during which Umamusume can demonstrate their running prowess and compete in races is limited.
Eventually, their strength fades, and the time for retirement arrives.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The period when one runs fastest...
One's so-called "peak" doesn't last long.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I suspect K.S.Miracle feels that
this is her "peak"—
and that's why she's rushing to make her mark now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...Furthermore."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, Trainer.
I've done nothing but cause you trouble."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Still... this will be the last time.
Just until the Sprinters Stakes is fine, so...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Because right there...
I'll probably use up everything I have.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...I've felt it since around the start of summer.
That little by little, the end is drawing near.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "The miracle everyone gave me has surely... reached its limit here."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So――yeah.
……It'll be over soon.
I'm sorry……just a little more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...K.S. Miracle is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I think she is extremely sensitive when it comes
to herself, rather than "what everyone gave her"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether right now is your 'peak,'
and whether it will soon come to an end...
You can never truly know unless you keep on running.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Yet for her, the option to 'take a break and keep racing' simply doesn't exist. No—she never had that choice to begin with."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If the "miracle of everyone" that keeps me running disappears, that's where it ends.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Born with a fragile body, constantly supported by those around her, she feels an overwhelming sense that she was 'kept alive.'
...That is the only way she can see it.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ? ...Trainer?
choice_data_list: ...Shouldn't you start getting ready for the Winning Live?
...Shouldn't you start getting ready for the Winning Live?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah. ...You're right.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, and thanks a lot.
I'm gonna head out now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching her slender back as she walks away,
I make a single resolution.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having 'made her run,'
I will take full responsibility—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The resolve to betray her.
